caption_english: Twelve synthetic feasible candidates: cost is minimized and benefit maximized. Non-dominance refers only to this tested set. Three named options illustrate preference choices, not a unique optimum. Lower bars give successive benefit increases from zero to Lean, Lean to Balanced and Balanced to High benefit; they are not benefit/cost ratios.
panel_roles: Compare incremental benefit of named alternatives
production_use: Adapt one drawing function to frozen results; replace data contract and caption.
